newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-MUNICH VENUE FOR EUROPEAN CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MUNICH VENUE FOR EUROPEAN CUP FINAL.

text.p: The Olympic Stadium in Munich will stage the European Cup final on May 28, UEFA president Lennart Johansson said on Thursday.
Feyenoord's Rotterdam stadium will host the European Cup Winners' Cup final on May 14.

Munich last staged the final in 1993 when Marseille became the first French side to win the trophy, beating AC Milan 1-0. The only other European Cup final held there was in 1979 when Nottingham Forest beat Malmo, also by a single goal.
Rotterdam has held five previous Cup Winners' Cup finals, the last in 1991 when Manchester United beat Barcelona.
